caseNameFull: Chisom v. Roemer, Governor of Louisiana and United States v. Roemer, Governor of Louisiana

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of petitioners in No. 90-757 to expedite consideration of petition for writ of certiorari in No. 90-757 granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 917 F. 2d 187.
